**Results**

| Protein | Gene | UniProt | Sequence length | Mass (kDa) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Phospholipid phosphatase 3 | PLPP3 | O14495 | 311 aa | 35.12 |
| Proto-oncogene Mas | MAS1 | P04201 | 325 aa | 37.46 |

MAS1 (37.46 kDa) is heavier than PLPP3 (35.12 kDa).

**Important caveat:** UniProt's PLPP3 record contains stale/inconsistent metadata — its header, `SQ` line, and search/JSON `length`/`molWeight` fields report **389 AA / 43,895 Da**, whereas the actual sequence (FASTA, JSON sequence value, XML `<sequence>` element), the EBI Proteins API (311 aa / 35,116 Da), NCBI RefSeq NP_003704.3, and Ensembl ENSP00000360296 all give **311 aa**. Using the erroneous 43.9 kDa annotation would wrongly make PLPP3 appear heavier, so this is flagged as a concern.
